items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: And we actually saw the incident which has been in a few books, where a waiter dropped a plate or made some noise, and Bugsy Siegel literally kicked the guy out of the room.

ctx.x: Lena Romai(?). Xavier Cugat's band was the featured orchestra, and Lena Horne was the featured attraction. And she took Arnold Ross and Irving Ashby and myself. We were her trio. And we actually saw the incident which has been in a few books, where a waiter dropped a plate or made some noise, and Bugsy Siegel literally kicked the guy out of the room. And that was during... During that period in Las Vegas, Blacks couldn't stay on whatever side of town it was. We stayed over in a place called the Dust Bowl.
